description: An Arabic-first web app that uses OpenStreetMap for map display and user geolocation, then recommends crops that can be planted for the user's local area. Recommendations include sowing or transplanting months, harvest timing or whether harvesting can be continuous, and suitable soil.

dataRequirements.geographicCoverage: Nationwide coverage across all of Sudan, with recommendations resolved to the user's location rather than inferred from a single national calendar.
dataRequirements.provenance: Every crop, calendar, climate, and soil claim shown to users must include its source, reference period, and last-checked date. Mark modeled or approximate values as estimates; do not present national-level observations as local planting advice.

authoritativeSources.name: FAO GIEWS Sudan Country Brief
authoritativeSources.use: Official country-level crop-season updates, production assessments, and observed seasonal conditions.

authoritativeSources.name: FAO GAEZ v4 Data Portal
authoritativeSources.use: Global agro-ecological zones and modeled crop suitability; present suitability as modeled, not a guarantee of yield.

authoritativeSources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids
authoritativeSources.use: Global modeled soil-property layers; show spatial resolution and uncertainty and do not imply a field soil test.

authoritativeSources.name: NASA POWER
authoritativeSources.use: Location-based historical and near-real-time meteorological data to support climate context, not a substitute for local forecasts.

options.label: JavaScript

questions.question: Which framework should the recommendation API use?

options.description: A managed serverless option for the recommendation API.

questions.question: Which country or geographic region should PlantNow support first? Please be as specific as practical (for example, country plus state/province or region); planting calendars and suitable soil vary by location.
questions.rationale: The user requested coverage across all of Sudan. Recommendations must still use the user's local coordinates and clearly disclose gaps in subnational data.

questions.question: Which data stores should PlantNow use?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only if no persistence or service-associated storage is needed.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Store structured crop, regional planting-calendar, harvest, and soil-suitability data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Azure Functions-associated storage and optional static/media files.

questions.rationale: Structured regional crop guidance needs persistence. Azure Functions also requires its associated AzureWebJobsStorage account, represented here by Blob Storage.
